change_from_v1.mapping_diagnostic: e788a771 (WORKER_REPORT_S32_MAPPING_DIAG.md): V/PF Boyd mapping consistent with the dual update to machine precision; ||y|| at cycle 1 includes one pre-loop lambda update performed by the initialization call to _update_interface_power_flow_variables (update_tn=True). Pre-existing behaviour, identical in s31c; recorded, not changed.
change_from_v1.what: balancing dual ratio uses s_rho_part instead of full s; stopping rule unchanged
why: Residual balancing adjusts rho because rho trades r against s; the proximal component gamma*||dz|| does not scale with rho, so once rho < gamma a decrease barely lowers the balancing ratio and the rule can walk rho toward the clamp (Advisor concern C3).

Preflight evidence (commit 7305a476, cycle 1, rho = gamma = 1): PF dual ratio 7734.2 vs decrease threshold 3 x 2541.6 = 7624.8 -> decreased; with the rho part only 5468.9 -> held. V 178.13 vs 5 x 31.34 = 156.69 -> decreased; rho part only 125.96 -> held. Both v1 decisions were decided by the proximal part.
The configured P5.9-B/AB1 mechanism (Addendum 9 3.3(a) "as configured") never included the proximal term in its dual measure.

what: rho adaptation frozen after cycle 30 (was unlimited)
change_from_v2.why: Addendum 14 decisions after P5_15_S32_BOYD_GATE_REPORT.md: fixed gamma turned the TSO update into a proximal-gradient drift once balancing lowered rho, and fed the rho collapse; ADMM requires an eventually constant rho

a_D5_esso_scaling.authorized: Addendum 15 item 5(a): ESSO objective on the same sigma convention as the networks
a_D5_esso_scaling.flagged_for_author: deviation in FORM from the literal wording, not in substance; stated in the gate report
a_D5_esso_scaling.implemented_as: multiply the ESSO AL terms (dual and rho/2) by a fixed recorded constant al_scale_esso = sigma / w_ref, w_ref = median TSO/DSO block weight; the ESSO base objective expression is NOT divided
a_D5_esso_scaling.preflight_gate: one ESSO solve before the gate: mu_final, s_obj, complementarity ratio and spurious throughput must not worsen versus the s33e2 baseline; if they worsen, STOP and report (eps or ESSO tol must be revisited first, Addendum 15 item 2)
a_D5_esso_scaling.why_this_form: argmin-identical (the two differ by an overall positive factor) but numerically safe: dividing the ESSO base by ~2e5 would shrink PENALTY_ESSO_SLACK (1e3), which ENFORCES the storage dynamics and feeds get_feasibility_violation, to ~5e-3 against AL terms of order rho, letting the ESSO buy consensus by violating its own energy balance; it would also weaken the barrier-leak identity min(pch,pdch) = mu/(s_obj*eps) that EFC/day - the gate diagnostic - depends on

b_sigma_fixed.placement: unchanged: effective_scale = sigma / block_weight per block; obj = objective.expr / effective_scale
b_sigma_fixed.source: case file admm.objective_scale (new key, per case study); _compute_common_admm_objective_scale stays wired and its computed value is asserted within a factor 3 of the fixed constant, failing loudly outside the calibration range
b_sigma_fixed.why_per_block: dividing by the block weight is what makes each block economics-to-penalty ratio comparable; dropping it makes stiffness inversely proportional to block weight

c_rho_policy.freeze: per channel: freeze once rho has not changed for 10 consecutive cycles AND balancing has acted at least once on that channel; a channel frozen at the clamp (1e-4 or 1e4) is a GATE FAILURE, recorded as rho_at_clamp; global backstop: all channels frozen from cycle 60 regardless
c_rho_policy.gamma: unchanged from v3: gamma_c = tau*rho_c, tau = 1, read from the model in force
c_rho_policy.provenance: V and PF: the values their own balancing settled on by cycle 30 in s33e2. ESS: Planner-derived from the measured arbitrage gradient (dz = g/(rho*a^2); target coordinate |p|/(2*S_ref) ~ 0.065 for EFC/day ~ 1; cycles-to-target ~ 478*rho gives ~24 cycles at 0.05); defensible range 0.03-0.10. NO committed prior source for 0.05 - it is a Planner choice recorded here before the run.

diagnostics_and_benchmarks.cycle_30_early_read: boyd_ess_norm_z, boyd_ess_r/s, rho_ess, per-node ESSO throughput, and cos(step_k, step_k-1). Addendum 15 predicts equilibrium by ~50 cycles, so by cycle 30 storage should be at tens of percent of rating with cos falling below 1. Storage at 1-2 % of rating with cos = 1.000 means the prediction has already failed and the run is read then, not at 150.

efc_reference.reading: EFC/day is read against EFC*, never against the retired 1.1. EFC* exceeds the SoH-binding threshold, so an equilibrium near 1.46 with the SoH constraint active is the expected success case; s33e2 terminal was 0.067 = 3.6 % of EFC*

diagnostics_and_benchmarks.s_ref_prediction: recorded SEPARATELY from the pass test: at matched conditions S_ref 2.5 vs 2*max(S,0.10) multiplies a = 1/(2S) by 0.3875, and with s ~ ||g||/a the ESS dual ratio should rise x2.58 (3.245 -> ~8.4) while eps_dual moves <1 % (it is 99.9 % the sqrt(n)*eps_abs floor). x1.0 would mean the residual is not gradient-limited; x0.39 would mean the mechanism is misidentified.
diagnostics_and_benchmarks.storage_response_falsifier: per-entry ESS step at matched rho_ess and matched normalization, before (s33e2) vs after (s34). Addendum 15 attributes the slow motion to coordination stiffness of order sigma; removing it should raise the step by orders of magnitude. If the step rises by less than 3x AND cos(step_k, step_k-1) stays at 1.000, the stiffness reading fails on its own terms and must be recorded as such.

gamma_policy.citation: Deng, W. and Yin, Z. (2016), On the global and linear convergence of the generalized alternating direction method of multipliers, Journal of Scientific Computing 66, 889-916
gamma_policy.definition: gamma_c = tau * rho_c per channel c in {v, pf, ess}, tau = 1 (case file proximal_regularization.tso.tau)
gamma_policy.fallback: gamma = 0 only if this gate fails; NOT run automatically - stop for review
gamma_policy.implementation_requirement: TSO prox_gamma_v/pf/ess become mutable Params (they are immutable today, shared_resources_planning.py update_transmission_model_to_admm); get_admm_boyd_residual_metrics reads gamma from the model, not from the case-file constant
gamma_policy.initialization: gamma_c = tau * initial rho_c (case file rho 1.0, so gamma 1.0) at model construction
gamma_policy.role: stabiliser, not method: at a fixed point the proximal term vanishes, so the solved problem is unchanged
gamma_policy.update: whenever the residual-balancing update changes rho_c (TSO, DSO, ESSO common factor), the TSO prox_gamma_c Param is set to tau * the new TSO rho_c before the next solve; the proximal term remains centred at the previous successful TSO iterate (unchanged)

predictions.stop_cycle: UNCERTAIN, stated honestly: extrapolating s34 measured rates, EFC reaches the threshold near cycle ~440 while the storage dual residual would reach 1.0 near ~550, beyond the cap; the stop inside 500 therefore depends on the residual collapsing when the floor binds. A cap outcome with EFC at the threshold and the residual falling is a distinct result from a cap outcome with EFC still rising.

stopping_rule.definition: unchanged from v3: Boyd per channel, all three channels, 3 consecutive converged cycles, eps_abs 1e-5, eps_rel 1e-4

eps_abs_derivation.limitation: fixed-input local-solver repeatability and tolerance sensitivity at cycle-7 TSO and DSO blocks; ESSO and cross-cycle ADMM effects not measured
eps_abs_derivation.rule: max(1e-5, 3 * max_c delta_c) rounded up to 1eK/3eK = max(1e-5, 1.98e-7) = 1e-5
eps_abs_derivation.source: E4 noise floor, data/SRP1/Results/P515S33/E4/e4_noise_floor_results.json (commit 24f808d7) under frozen spec data/SRP1/Results/P515S33/frozen_e4_noise_floor_spec_v1_35f54dfe.json

stopping_rule.eps_dual: sqrt(n) * eps_abs + eps_rel * ||y||, y in model units (V: lambda/v_base; PF: lambda/s_base; ESS: as stored)
stopping_rule.eps_justification: eps_rel matches the s31c objective relative tolerance (1e-4) and the ~1e-4 relative accuracy needed for the 0.37 % storage ranking signal; eps_abs 1e-5 RMS normalized is comparable to the relative term for PF and above local-solve feasibility noise. Advisor-derived, not tuned; provisional until sigma is fixed in 3.4.
stopping_rule.mapping_ess: unchanged from v2, TSO proximal block uses gamma_ess in force
stopping_rule.mapping_v_pf: unchanged from v2, with gamma the value IN FORCE at the cycle TSO solve: s = sqrt(rho_c^2 + gamma_c^2) * (z_TSO^k - z_TSO^(k-1)); s_rho_part = rho_c * dz; s_proximal_part = gamma_c * dz; rho_c and gamma_c read from the TSO model Params before the end-of-cycle penalty update
stopping_rule.norms: Euclidean over all normalized entries (nodes x years x days x periods [x p,q] [x agents]); no probability or annualization weights
stopping_rule.objective_change_test: diagnostic only: |dQ| vs max(1e3, 1e-4 * scale) as in s31c, reported per cycle with its rule-ten ratio; not a stopping criterion
